basic_info.description: Probate Sale without Court Confirmation  Romeo 6 unit investment 0pportunity in the heart of San Francisco's Inner Mission. This property consist of 3 bedroom/ 1 bath full floor units with a gross 6,465 Sqaure feet, built in 1907. All units are occupied at below market rate rents. The upper units have decks with partial eastern views.  Each unit is individually metered for PG&E with separate hot water heaters. The heat is supplied by gas wall furnace units. There is a full basement with ADU potential.
